studyTitle: Comparative Study of Manual vs. Automated Software Deployment
summary: An empirical benchmark evaluating manual deployment procedures against Jenkins-based automated CI/CD pipelines across five foundational software delivery metrics.

parameters.name: Deployment Time
parameters.description: Total elapsed time from initiating the release sequence to verifying the application is live and operational in production.
manualBreakdown: SSH into application server: ~5 mins
Manual Git pull & conflict resolution: ~10 mins
Installing updated dependencies: ~12 mins
Running database migration scripts: ~15 mins
Building static asset bundles: ~10 mins
Restarting systemd services & web server: ~5 mins
Manual smoke testing and verification: ~8 mins
automatedBreakdown: Jenkins Webhook triggered from Git: <10 secs
Automated checkout & workspace prep: ~30 secs
Parallel test suite & linting checks: ~2 mins
Automated Docker build & image push: ~1.5 mins
Blue/Green zero-downtime rolling update: ~1 min
Automated synthetic health check: ~20 secs

parameters.name: Human Effort
parameters.description: Total active engineering time demanded from developers, DevOps engineers, and QA personnel during a deployment event.
manualBreakdown: Pre-deployment synchronization call: ~30 mins
Active manual command execution: ~45 mins
Post-deployment manual validation by QA: ~45 mins
Total active team hours spent: 2.5 hours per release
automatedBreakdown: Pull Request approval & merge: ~5 mins
Autonomous Jenkins execution: 0 human touchpoints
Automated Slack/Email build notification: Instantaneous
Total active team hours spent: ~6 minutes per release

parameters.name: Error Rate
parameters.description: Probability of human-introduced mistakes such as missed configuration values, branch mix-ups, typos, or omitted migration steps.
manualBreakdown: Copy-paste mistakes in environment files (.env): Common
Forgotten database migration execution: High risk
Stale cache or uncompiled asset bundles: Frequent
File permission errors on target host: Occasional
automatedBreakdown: Versioned Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Enforced
Centralized Jenkins credentials management: Secure
Deterministic Docker image packaging: 100% reproducible
Zero manual keyboard inputs on production servers: Eliminates typo risk

parameters.name: Failure Frequency
parameters.description: Rate at which production deployments trigger downtime, regressions, or immediate deployment aborts.
manualBreakdown: Untested code path slips into release: ~8%
Server environment drift (differing OS packages): ~6%
Broken dependency version resolution: ~4.5%
automatedBreakdown: Quality gates block bad builds prior to deployment: 98%
Isolated immutable containerized environments: Zero drift
Strict automated regression checks in staging: 99%

parameters.name: Recovery Time (MTTR)
parameters.description: Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) required to revert a failed release to the previous stable state.
manualBreakdown: Triage & emergency Slack troubleshooting: ~25 mins
Locating previous stable commit and artifacts: ~15 mins
Manual rollback commands and DB restore: ~25 mins
Manual service reboot and sanity testing: ~10 mins
automatedBreakdown: Automated health check detects failure: ~15 secs
Automated rollback triggered in Jenkins: ~30 secs
Traffic switched back to previous stable container: ~30 secs
Total automated restoration time: under 2 minutes
